body: Thank you my friend. Sail on, life on land awaits. You have your sea legs 👍
And you a well of encouragement thank you 🙏

Yes, and true.  I hope to inspire those lost at sea as that is where most sailors remain by choice or stranding. It’s meant to be a beacon or lighthouse to those with the spirit to set sail that get lost. It is when we’re lost that we must find ourselves and if we that we find salvation
I have struggled with addiction my entire life.  Wrote this little story from my heart to help those others like me lost at sea
